BiblicalUsage: Ka-ac is vexation — the sharp irritation that provokes and grieves, whether it comes from a rival or from our own folly. Peninnah provoked Hannah sore to make her fret; the Preacher warns that anger rests in the bosom of fools; and Moses says God saw the provoking of His sons and daughters and abhorred them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe vexation is a warning light, not a virtue. It shows me where I am provoking others or being provoked into sin — and the wise answer is not to nurse it but to bring it to the God who is slow to anger.
